blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Security and Privacy Foundations**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol II, Security & Privacy, § Security and Privacy Foundations
blocks.md: Defense starts by separating two concerns that often share the same vocabulary. Security asks how an adversary can steal, manipulate, or disable the fleet; privacy asks how sensitive information can leak or be inferred even when the system behaves as designed. Keeping those questions separate determines which controls belong at each layer: authentication and isolation around adversarial pathways, provenance and monitoring across the release chain, and privacy accounting wherever learned parameters carry traces of the data that produced them.

questions.q: The section **Security and Privacy Foundations** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy bounds how much one protected unit can change a release, named by an adjacency relation, so it holds against any auxiliary information, and noise scaled to sensitivity over epsilon costs small groups the most.

In synchronous data parallelism one compromised worker contributes to every replica's update and the mean's breakdown point is zero, so integrity needs robust aggregation rules whose gather-based traffic exceeds a ring AllReduce's.

De-identification and k-anonymity constrain only the shape of a released table, and federated learning, secure aggregation, homomorphic encryption, secure computation, and synthetic data each exclude a different observer, and none of them bounds what the released model or aggregate reveals.

Attacks on a learned system arrive through interfaces the fleet exposes on purpose, so a threat model writes down asset, trust boundary, adversary capability and goal, and control, and keeps model visibility separate from write capability; the serving interface adds prompt injection, which crosses the boundary between instructions and data, and denial of wallet, which spends the cost budget while the endpoint stays available.
